🧠 FOREX SMC MARKET MAP — EURCHF + EURCAD

Fresh market data | Daily → 4H → 1H → 15M
Latest completed 1H reference used because the feed's live spot/15M window hit its per-minute limit.
No setup is an entry until 15M confirmation occurs.

🔥 STRONGEST SETUP — EURCHF SELL
Latest completed 1H reference: ~0.9319

HTF READ
• Daily structure is bearish after the rejection from ~0.9490 and the sharp breakdown through 0.9360.
• 4H rejected ~0.9369 and expanded lower toward 0.9296.
• 1H is recovering from the selloff, creating a potential retracement rather than a confirmed reversal.

🎯 PRIMARY SHORT
Wait for a retracement into 0.9328–0.9336, then require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ 0.9312
→ 0.92963
→ 0.9271

Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~0.9341.
Stronger structural invalidation above ~0.9370.

🟠 EURCAD SELL — SECONDARY
Latest completed 1H reference: ~1.5923

HTF READ
• Daily structure remains bearish after rejection from ~1.6140 and the subsequent break toward 1.5908.
• 4H structure is bearish; price has begun recovering from the 1.59075 low.
• The recovery is treated as a retracement while price remains below the 1.5980–1.6005 supply area.

🎯 PRIMARY SHORT
Wait for a retracement into 1.5935–1.5950, then require bearish 15M displacement/reclaim.

Targets:
→ 1.5912
→ 1.59075
→ 1.5888

Invalidation: sustained acceptance above ~1.5962.
Stronger structural invalidation above ~1.60045.

⚠️ SMC VERDICT
EURCHF SELL is the cleaner setup because the higher-timeframe breakdown is more pronounced and the POI sits closer to the current retracement.
EURCAD SELL is also valid conditionally, but patience is required for price to return to the preferred zone.

Do not chase either pair at the current reference levels.

Educational market analysis — not financial advice.
